questions.solution:
Sum and difference again — componendo–
dividendo turns each pair straight into a ratio. 
 Step 1   Convert both given pairs. 
(A + B)/(A − B) = 11/1   ⇒  A : B = (11 + 1) : (11 − 1) = 
12 : 10 = 6 : 5 
(B + C)/(B − C) = 11/1   ⇒  B : C = 6 : 5 
 Step 2   B is the common term — equalise it. 
 
 Step 3   Total the units and value one of them. 
36 + 30 + 25 = 91 units = ₹1,82,000   ∴  1 unit = 
₹2,000 
 Step 4   B is 30 units. 
B = 30 × 2,000 = ₹60,000

questions.question: A dog takes 8 jumps for every 12 jumps of the lion and a fox takes 15 jumps for every 12 jumps of the lion. Distance covered in 8 dog jumps = 16 lion jumps = 24 fox jumps. Find ratio of their speeds.
questions.solution:
Speed = (jumps in the same time) × (length of 
one jump). Take one LION jump as the unit. 
 Step 1   Read the jump lengths off the distance 
line. 
8 dog = 16 lion   ⇒  1 dog jump = 2 lion jumps 
24 fox = 16 lion   ⇒  1 fox jump = ⅔ lion jump 
 Step 2   Multiply each animal's rate by its own 
jump length. 
 
16 : 12 : 10  =  8 : 6 : 5

questions.question: Two candles of same height are lighted simultaneously. First burns in 8 hours, second in 6 hours. After how many hours does the ratio of 1st to 2nd candle become 2:1?
questions.solution:
Both candles start at the same height, so work 
with the FRACTION left, never the height. 
 Step 1   After t hours, write what is left of each. 
first = (8 − t)/8  of its height          second = (6 − 
t)/6  of its height 
 Step 2   The leftovers are in 2 : 1. 
(8 − t)/8 = 2 × (6 − t)/6   ⇒  3(8 − t) = 8(6 − t) 
 Step 3   Solve. 
24 − 3t = 48 − 8t   ⇒  5t = 24   ∴  t = 4.8 h = 4 
hours 48 minutes

What will be the average of first 50 positive even numbers?
questions.solution:
Write the numbers out before averaging — the 
pattern does the work. 
 Step 1   The first 50 even numbers are 2, 4, … 100. 
sum = 2(1 + 2 + … + 50) = 2 × (50 × 51)/2 = 2,550 
 Step 2   Divide by how many there are. 
2,550 / 50 = 51        (= n + 1, with n = 50)

questions.question: Find the average of the cubes of first five natural numbers.
questions.solution:
Cubes have their own sum formula — use it 
rather than adding 1 + 8 + 27 + … 
 Step 1   Sum of the first n cubes. 
[n(n+1)/2]² = [5 × 6/2]² = 15² = 225 
 Step 2   Divide by n. 
225 / 5 = 45

questions.question: The average of 39 numbers is zero. How many of those numbers can be greater than zero? 39
questions.solution:
An average of zero means the positives are 
exactly cancelled by the negatives. 
 Step 1   At least one number must be negative. 
so at most 39 − 1 = 38 can be greater than zero

questions.question: A cricket team scored 156 runs in 30 overs. It has to make 275 runs in 50 overs. How many average runs does it need per over in the remaining overs?
questions.solution:
Work in runs still needed, not in run rates. 
 Step 1   Runs already made and runs still 
required. 
156 scored,  275 − 156 = 119 still needed 
 Step 2   Overs left. 
50 − 30 = 20   ⇒  119 / 20 = 5.95 an over
